Race-report data streams from ZwiftPower

zp_analysis.Rd

The data behind ZwiftPower's race report (racereport.php): a rider's second-by-second power, heart rate and altitude through one event, from api3.php?do=analysis.

Usage

zp_analysis(s, race_id, zwift_id, parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zp"))

zp_event_analysis(
  s,
  race_id,
  pen = NULL,
  zwift_ids = NULL,
  ...,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

s

A zp_session().

race_id

ZwiftPower (= Zwift) event id.

zwift_id

Zwift rider id.

parse

"tbl" for the tidy stream tibble, or "json" / "resp" for the raw payload (zp_analysis() only).

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds.

pen

Optional pen (category) letter(s), e.g. "B".

zwift_ids

Optional rider ids to restrict to.

...

Passed to zp_analysis() (e.g. ttl).

progress

Show a progress bar.

Value

A tibble with one row per sample: zwid, time (seconds from the rider's start), distance (km), then one column per stream ZwiftPower holds for the rider — usually power (W), heart_rate (bpm) and altitude (m); cadence (rpm) and speed (km/h) appear when present, other streams are named after their unit. A rider with no data gives zero rows. zp_event_analysis() adds name and category from the results.

Details

zp_analysis() fetches one rider. zp_event_analysis() fetches every finisher in an event's results, optionally only one pen or a set of riders, one request per rider (each cached, so re-runs are cheap).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zp <- zp_set_cookie(zp_session(), Sys.getenv("ZP_SID"))
winner <- zp_analysis(zp, 5811034, 1366959)
pen_b  <- zp_event_analysis(zp, 5811034, pen = "B")
} # }
